title: Crisha, nakatanggap ng phone call mula kay Long | Kapamilya Deal Or No Deal
summary: Despite being absent on the set of “Kapamilya, Deal Or No Deal”, Lucky Star Long Mejia still managed to reach out to wish September 19 celebrity player Crisha Uy good luck via a supportive phone call.
